artifacts.summary: All eleven Pthm principles plus the P8 pair verified to compile zero-sorry via lean_run_code; recommends a new FormalSystem/Theorems/Interaction.lean, flags two errors in the task description, and shows the five biconditionals have no rewrite-lemma consumer in this tree.

user_decision.question: P8 siting departs from an explicit task instruction: the task asks for it 'sited beside temporalDualityNeg / temporalDualityNegRev and following their proof shape', but under this tree's definition of `sometimes` P8 is definitionally double negation (doubleNegation / notNotIntro one-liners), and MonotonicityDuality.lean's noncomputable section would make a computable lemma noncomputable. Research recommends siting it in the new Interaction.lean instead, following the fNegG/pNegH precedent. Confirm, or require the beside-P7 siting.
user_decision.default: Site P8 in the new FormalSystem/Theorems/Interaction.lean with a docstring citing both the P7 pair (contrast) and fNegG/pNegH (precedent).
